skips.reason: The adapter requires an existing .NET 9 trimmed browser-wasm publish directory (DOTNET_WASM_DIR) with blazor.boot.json and dotnet.js. Hosted runners do not provide that application-specific runtime; this repository does not vendor it. Installing a desktop SDK does not establish this prerequisite.
skips.removalCondition: Provision and pin an independently built .NET browser-wasm application/runtime, record its hashes, set DOTNET_WASM_DIR, and pass scripts/validate-clr-wasm.js on each claimed target. The test-only type-forwarding facade must remain explicitly labeled.
